command.unknown: I can only help add, delete, or change events. e.g. 'Delete tomorrow's physics quiz', 'Move today's workout to 6'
command.need_title: Which event? Please tell me its title.
command.not_found: I couldn't find an event matching '{title}'.
command.ambiguous: Several events match: {candidates}. Which one? (Say 'all' for every one.)
command.ask_scope: '{title}' repeats. Change just one occurrence, or the whole series?
command.nothing_to_update: Tell me what to change. You can change the time, title, importance, place, or deadline.
command.confirm: {count} events will be affected: {targets}. Go ahead?
command.title_applies_to_series: Title and importance apply to the whole series.
change.title: title {before}→{after}
undo.newer_change_exists: Undo the more recent change first.
command.ask_repeat_until: Repeat until the end of {name} ({start}–{end})? If it ends on another date, just tell me.
command.ask_repeat_until_none: Until when should it repeat? Tell me a date (e.g. until Dec 20).
command.confirm_create_with_range: Create this? A new repeat period '{name}' ({start}–{end}) will be created too.
range.need_dates: Tell me when the period ends. e.g. 'Create Exams from Dec 1 to Dec 12'
range.need_name: Which period? Tell me its name.
range.not_found: I couldn't find a period named '{name}'.
range.nothing_to_update: What should I change? e.g. 'Make it end on Dec 10'
range.invalid_dates: The end date is before the start date.
range.list_empty: You have no repeat periods yet.
range.in_use: {count} repeating events use '{name}': {events}. What should I do?
undo.range_in_use: Some events still use this period, so it can't be undone.
draft.updated: I updated the draft. Create it like this?
draft.unchanged: The draft is unchanged. Create it like this?
draft.unclear: Tell me what to change, e.g. 'Move it to 7' or 'Importance 5'. Say 'OK' to create it as is.
draft.end_before_start: The end time is before the start ({start}). When does it end?
draft.end_equals_start: The end time is the same as the start ({start}). When does it end?
draft.ask_travel_minutes: '{name}' is a new place. How many minutes does it take to get there?
draft.new_location: The place '{name}' ({minutes} min away) will be registered too.
draft.ask_frequency: How often should it repeat? e.g. every Wednesday
draft.start_weekday_mismatch: {date} is a {weekday}. For a {days} repeat, which date should be the first one?
command.ask_location_minutes: How many minutes does it take to get to {name}?
command.location_applies_to_series: The place applies to the whole series ({days}). Go ahead?
command.retry_ask: Could you tell me the date and time again?
command.not_found_suggest: I couldn't find '{title}'. Did you mean one of these? {candidates}
persona.fallback_default: I'm not sure what you mean. Would you tell me about your day?
